title: Steel wire armoured cable (SWA)
summary: Introduces steel wire armoured (SWA) cable installation: choosing glands, using a shroud outdoors, and supporting the cable with clips, cleats or tie raps.

sections.heading: SWA glands
paragraphs: Glands are used to terminate SWA cable and come in different types: indoor glands and outdoor glands. A shroud must always be used when the gland is outside.

sections.heading: Supporting SWA cable
paragraphs: Clips come in a variety of shapes and sizes. SWA can be installed on a wall using a cleat. When installing on tray, tie raps may be used.
bullets: On a wall: use a cleat
On tray: tie raps may be used

sections.heading: Following the regulations
paragraphs: Whichever fixing method is used, always follow BS 7671 when installing SWA.
